# Project kickoff doc (sloppy input)

## Why this matters

In today's fast-paced AI landscape, we need to leverage cutting-edge
technology to elevate our developer experience. This is a load-bearing
initiative for the platform team. Let me explain why.

## Background

The platform team has been working hard to facilitate a robust deployment
pipeline. Recent investments have empowered us to ship a state-of-the-art
solution that delivers seamless integration across our ecosystem. We're
seeing some really exciting numbers (around 40% improvement in deploy
frequency!), and stakeholders have been amazing in their support.

## Proposal

We propose three issues, one solution: (1) deployment friction, (2)
observability gaps, (3) on-call toil. The proposed turnkey approach is
our new internal platform "DeployFlow" which synergizes existing tools
into a holistic ecosystem. This will be a paradigm shift for the team.

## Why this matters (again)

This is critically important. The team will be empowered to focus on
high-value work instead of low-value toil. Stakeholders will be excited.
Stay tuned for more updates!
